title: Ensure 'Prevent users from sharing files within their profile.' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: User Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Network Sharing\Prevent users from sharing files within their profile to 'Enabled'
reason: If not properly configured, a user could accidentally share sensitive data with unauthorized users. In an enterprise managed environment, the company should provide a managed location for file sharing.
